ranking_method.stage_1: Subtract exact 139-requirement support; planned_test_id membership remains routing metadata only.
ranking_method.stage_2: Treat a primitive as an existing dependency surface only when Runner A has independent primary support for that primitive; recompute dependency-closed primary cores and single-dependency unlocks.
ranking_method.stage_3: Regroup dependency-closed rows by shared evidence and semantic sub-surface; reject same-file groups that mix unopened evaluator families or unrelated semantics.
ranking_method.stage_4: Rank tight clusters by corrected primitive leverage, unlocked case count, shared-evidence density, reusable predicate density, then incremental semantic surface size.

broad_zero_unmet_state.note: Only primaries with an existing Runner-A surface are counted here. Newly dependency-closed unopened primaries remain candidates for future evaluator families rather than being treated as implemented.

reusable_predicates: existing adapter record/declaration indexing and local-reference resolution
existing CaptureDiagnostic subject/slot machinery from tool-adapter support
existing RequestSnapshot/RequestBinding indexing and request transition machinery

tight_cluster_comparison.name: verifier_conflict_completeness
tight_cluster_comparison.reason_not_selected: Lower corrected primitive leverage and smaller tight cluster than the provider adapter request/attempt baseline.

tight_cluster_comparison.name: provider_streaming_boundary
tight_cluster_comparison.reason_not_selected: Same primitive leverage but fewer cases and a broader streaming-output surface than the selected request/attempt core.

tight_cluster_comparison.name: mixed_minimal_signed_receipt
tight_cluster_comparison.reason: The same-file group mixes an unopened integrity-composition evaluator family with verifier-report rows; file co-location is not a semantic cluster.

tight_cluster_comparison.reason: Receipt-multi and integrity rows are separate unopened primary surfaces. PAD-066 is also kept outside the selected provider request/attempt sub-surface because it is a transport-metadata proximity rule.

tight_cluster_comparison.name: receipt_multi_linkage
tight_cluster_comparison.reason_not_selected: Lower primitive leverage and requires opening the receipt-multi evaluator surface.

selected_cluster.selection_reason: prim.adapter.capture has the highest corrected single-step leverage at 109. The source-to-request provider adapter baseline is the largest semantically tight dependency-closed cluster on that top-ranked primitive after excluding the unrelated PAD-066 transport-metadata rule. It reuses existing adapter reference/diagnostic machinery, ProviderAttempt predicates, RequestSnapshot/RequestBinding machinery, and Batch 20 verifier status semantics while adding one bounded provider request/attempt adapter sub-surface.

intent: Select only PAD-001, PAD-011, PAD-013, PAD-018, PAD-021, PAD-025, PAD-031, PAD-032, and PAD-035 for Batch 21.
